card.text: Explore Rhea in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Cassini imagery and elevation maps of Saturn’s icy moon, its impact basins and bright fractures.

introduction.text: Saturn’s second-largest moon, an icy world covered in ancient craters, enormous impact basins and bright fractures. The shape view reveals a simplified Cassini SPC model. Relative albedo shows the model’s brightness variation; elevation uses its own stated reference sphere.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Surface detail and photographed shadows vary across the mosaic. Gray grid marks gaps; the map follows a simplified spacecraft shape model.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Colors extend beyond human vision and show real hemisphere differences. Photographed shading and source seams remain.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Color shows height above the PDS 763.5 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief at true height scale; Shadows adds shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 2.15 km grid spacing. The producer’s one-to-two-grid-spacing accuracy estimate is based on simulations; it is not an independent uncertainty measurement for Rhea. Gray grid marks uncovered raster edges. The globe follows a simplified Q128 source shape.

relative-albedo.title: SPC relative brightness model
relative-albedo.summary: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.

shape.title: SPC shape model
shape.summary: Neutral grid over a simplified source shape, without photographic texture or height exaggeration. Source model detail and accuracy vary. Cassini SPC Q128 model released in 2025. The 2,000-face view retains broad shape; small terrain details are omitted.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS infrared mosaic
infrared.summary: Photometrically corrected infrared spectra, shown as false color.

ice-absorption.title: Continuum-relative water-ice absorption; not ice abundance
ice-absorption.summary: Water-ice absorption strength, derived from the original spectra.
